text: install the argo workflows cli version v4.1.6 on linux
cmd: VERSION=v4.1.6 && curl -sLO "https://github.com/argoproj/argo-workflows/releases/download/$VERSION/argo-linux-amd64.gz" && gunzip argo-linux-amd64.gz && chmod +x argo-linux-amd64 && sudo mv argo-linux-amd64 /usr/local/bin/argo
